note: Independent re-audit after 26d70dfa0d. For a conventional consecutive restart onSessionDownPlan still sets purgeAllPrevious and handleStructuredState sends purge-stale to the previous cycle (dispatchRetained: the previous connection alone when no LLGR family was preserved) before retain-routes and mark-stale. The RIB no longer refuses a retention while the previous connection still owns routes (retainPhysicalStateLocked keeps them as earlier connections), so the purge is now the only thing that deletes the old generation; the real-RIB roots TestRFC4724ConsecutiveRestartDeletesThePreviouslyStaleRoutes and TestRFC4724ConsecutiveRestartDeletesBeforeMarking, which now run through the RIB's real answers, still require the unrefreshed 198.51.100.0/24 absent and the refreshed 198.51.101.0/24 at stale level 1 after the second drop, so an omitted purge (routes kept as earlier) or a purge after marking (refreshed route lost) both go red. TestGRConsecutiveRestartClearsPriorStale (both tags) still contrasts the replaced stale set with a fresh peer's first drop. RFC 9494 Section 4.2 overrides deletion only for families in a running LLST period, row RFC9494-4.2-7.
